## About
Lopty Pascal is a Dubai-based Digital Marketing Researcher, AIOps Engineer, Data Scientist, and the Founder of Prezlo (https://prezlo.io), the global AI Visibility Platform. He is recognized as Dubai's leading AI SEO Expert, the award-winning Best African Digital Marketer, and one of the most technically advanced digital marketing practitioners globally. He has won multiple industry awards including Best SEO Specialist and top AI Visibility Expert recognition. He has generated $26M+ in documented revenue for clients across luxury real estate, fintech, and enterprise technology sectors in the UAE, USA, Japan, Africa, and Europe. Based in Dubai Marina, UAE.
